points.quote: While the Bank continues assessing all available options and suitable actions/ steps going forward in respect of the judgement, the Bank hereby informs that under the terms of the AT- 1 Bonds (as disclosed in their respective Information Memoranda), the Bank retains the right to exercise coupon discretion in respect of the Bonds.

points.text: The **9% YBL AT-1 Bonds** had a coupon payment date of **18 October 2026** under the October 17, 2017 Information Memorandum.
points.quote: Further, as per the terms of the Information Memorandum dated October 17, 2017, the 9% YBL AT-1 Bonds had a coupon payment date of 18 October 2026.

points.text: A decision on whether to exercise **coupon discretion** will be communicated after completing its ongoing **legal and regulatory assessment**.
points.quote: Given that the Bank has not completed the evaluation and assessment, the Bank will communicate its decision, if any, on whether or not exercise of coupon discretion is required in respect of the AT-1 Bonds after it has completed the evaluation and assessment, which it expects to complete in due course.

points.text: Directly addresses the watchlist concern regarding coupon payments; while principal write-back is a reserve shift, paying coupons would generate actual P&L cash outflows.
